i.norm:
Verifies that, when a command line contains only positional arguments and no options at all, the parser leaves every option unset and collects the positional arguments as "extra" (unparsed) arguments.

Exercises some deprecated parser classes.

Builds an {@link Options} definition containing three mutually exclusive option groups plus a single standalone option:
  • group 1: {@code -f/--file} or {@code -d/--directory}
  • group 2: {@code -s/--section} or {@code -c/--chapter}
  • group 3: {@code --import} or {@code --export} (long options only)
  • standalone: {@code -r/--revision}
